title: isomacrolobium elongatum
intro: Isomacrolobium elongatum, commonly known as the 'African walnut', is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, thanks to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Isomacrolobium elongatum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins that exhibit antioxidant, antispasmodic, and expectorant activities. Additionally, the plant's bioactive constituents also display potential in providing protection against oxidative stress and inflammation, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and modern research.
